metadata.title: What a Complete Mechanism for a Lambda-Tied MOND Law Must Do: A Closure Map of Scoped No-Gos and a Specification
metadata.description:
The programme ties the MOND acceleration scale to the vacuum, a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda), with kappa = 1/2 fitted, never derived. Its best current effective law, candidate B, is the MOND kernel plus hierarchical ownership (only the outermost bound system carries the phantom) plus a cold component with the cosmic amount Omega_c h^2 ~ 0.12: the mass is still required, and no dark-matter particle is added. No committed action produces B. This note is a map and a specification, not a result.

The gaps. Three gaps separate B from a mechanism: a legal owned switch (Gap 1), the cold fluid that is the law's dark density (Gap 2), and the a0-Lambda tie with its coefficient (Gap 3).

What Lean certifies. A Lean library of 331 theorems (standard axioms only) certifies, from stated premises, that ownership is not a function of local field data, that a continuous law with no external-field effect is linear, that a length proportional to M^(1/2) needs an acceleration scale, and that an AQUAL action gives the kernel in spherical symmetry; it certifies no empirical fact.

The routes. We tabulate 25 committed routes to the missing object: 22 are scoped no-gos on their frozen classes, two owner-directed hand-checks find no mechanism, and one shows realisability only. None is a mechanism.

The specification. The failures sharpen the target: an early cold fluid present before structure forms (a dust created at turnaround supplies Omega h^2 = 0.1200 x 10^-1376.8 at z = 1100); ownership that remembers boundness (a causal latch keeps n = 0.791 at one free-fall time against the required 0.99); a distribution that carries the M^(1/2) scale itself (passive bound infall scales as M^(0.33-0.34), and relaxation at a vacuum-set rate reaches Gamma tau <= 0.79 against the ~4.1-4.2 needed); a target that is field-local in the Newtonian field but needs bound-domain labels; and no created rest mass.

Satellites and the coefficient. B's ultra-faint failure (3.5-3.9 sigma) does not move under the 2026 binary-corrected and DEIMOS dispersions, and the bound-core (LambdaCDM-comparator) reading is preferred at satellites by small margins: a lean, not a detection. kappa = 1/2 is fitted (0.465 +- 0.076 from the baryonic Tully-Fisher relation), and Milgrom's cH0/2pi footing fits SPARC as well.

What decides. Gaia DR4 (2 December 2026) is a survival test of B against the bare MOND law; B, LambdaCDM and Newton all predict gamma-hat = 1.000. The a0(z) side is limited by the baryon calibration (PAPER38, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23085582).

Every number carried by an audit row is re-read from committed files by PAPER39_audit.py (141 of 141); the tex is checked at block level, not sentence level, and numbers quoted only in running text are not checked by the script. The menu of routes was written knowing the target, and the referees were not blind. AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed; nothing here is claimed closed.
